title: @csp/validate rule engine (schema/range/enum/temporal/spatial/uniqueness/cross-field) + severities
context: Validation is the heart of turning messy volunteer observations into trustworthy data. @csp/validate provides pure, side-effect-free validators that produce a ValidationReport without ever auto-deleting flagged records, so humans and partners decide. It must cover the standard checks plus emit a before/after error-rate pair for the success metric. Depends on the csp-engine-002 spec/engine.
objective: Implement the @csp/validate rule engine covering schema/type, enum, numeric range, regex, temporal, spatial, uniqueness/duplicate, and cross-field checks, emitting a ValidationReport with error/warn/info severities and a before/after error-rate pair.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure, side-effect-free validators emit a ValidationReport (per-record + summary) with error/warn/info severities and never auto-delete flagged records
Covers schema/type, enum, numeric range, regex, temporal (parseable, not future, in window), spatial (coordinate-in-region, precision), uniqueness/duplicates, and cross-field consistency
Report records a before/after error-rate pair for the success metric
Golden-fixture tests (known-valid pass + deliberately malformed fail) pass in CI on synthetic data only
output: A PR adding the @csp/validate package with the rule engine, ValidationReport, severities, and passing golden-fixture tests.
